ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with dominant high-intensity (white) pixels in the interior regions and low-intensity (black) pixels along the distal and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones across both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation framing the outer trailing edges and distal tips; a single dark focal spot on the lower medial section of the left lobe; multiple vertical dark linear streaks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; amplitude is significantly higher and more jagged on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping from the submerged center toward acute, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of textured, tan/brown barnacle attachments located at the apex of both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel vertical dark linear marks (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and irregular, jagged tissue margins on the left lobe suggesting previous physical wear or trauma.
